title: Condicionales con Si: Practice
description: Authored B2 practice set for si clauses: real conditions (si + presente → futuro/presente/imperativo), hypotheticals (si + imperfecto de subjuntivo → condicional), and the two things si never takes: the future and the conditional.

lessons.summary: Spanish si clauses come in two everyday shapes. REAL (likely) conditions: si + PRESENTE in the if-half, and future, present or an imperative in the result: 'Si llueve, nos quedamos en casa', 'Si duerme bien, mañana estará de buen humor', 'Si llegas antes, avisame'. HYPOTHETICAL (unlikely or contrary to fact): si + IMPERFECTO DE SUBJUNTIVO, result in CONDICIONAL: 'Si tuviera más tiempo, estudiaría más', 'Si fuera vos, lo llevaría al médico'. The iron rules: after si you NEVER use the future ('si lloverá' is impossible, say 'si llueve') and NEVER the conditional ('si tendría' is a well-known error, say 'si tuviera'). Also worth having: 'como si' always takes the imperfect subjunctive ('Habla como si supiera todo'), and the set phrase 'si fuera tú / yo que tú' for giving advice.

examples.spanish: Si llueve, nos quedamos en casa.
examples.english: If it rains, we'll stay home.

examples.spanish: Si duerme la siesta, después está de mejor humor.
examples.english: If he naps, he's in a better mood afterwards.

examples.spanish: Si tuviéramos jardín, pasaríamos más tiempo afuera.
examples.english: If we had a garden, we'd spend more time outside.

examples.spanish: Si fuera tú, hablaría con la pediatra.
examples.english: If I were you, I'd talk to the paediatrician.
He spends as if he were a millionaire.

items.prompt: Si ___ mañana, no vamos a la plaza.
items.promptEnglish: If it rains tomorrow, we're not going to the square.
items.explanation: Real condition: si + presente. Si never takes the future, even when the meaning is future.

items.prompt: Si ___ más tiempo, estudiaría español todos los días.
items.promptEnglish: If I had more time, I'd study Spanish every day.
items.explanation: Hypothetical: si + imperfecto de subjuntivo (tuviera) → condicional. «Si tendría» is the famous error.

items.prompt: Si ___ tú, lo llevaría al pediatra hoy mismo. (ser, imperfecto de subjuntivo)
items.promptEnglish: If I were you, I'd take him to the paediatrician today.
items.explanation: The advice frame is fixed: si fuera tú (or si fuese tú) + conditional.

items.prompt: Si ___ tarde del trabajo, avisame y ceno sin ti.
items.promptEnglish: If you're leaving work late, let me know and I'll eat without you.
items.explanation: A likely, everyday condition stays real: si + presente, with an imperative in the result.

items.prompt: Si ganara más, ___ un piso con jardín.
items.promptEnglish: If I earned more, I'd buy a flat with a garden.
items.explanation: The result half of a hypothetical takes the conditional: compraría.

items.prompt: Si ___ vivir en cualquier ciudad, ¿cuál elegirías? (poder, imperfecto de subjuntivo, tú)
items.promptEnglish: If you could live in any city, which would you choose?
items.explanation: Hypothetical question: si + pudieras (imperfect subjunctive of poder).

items.prompt: Camina como si ya ___ caminar perfecto, y tiene un año.
items.promptEnglish: He walks as if he already knew how to walk perfectly, and he's one.
items.explanation: Como si ALWAYS takes the imperfect subjunctive, whatever the tense around it.

items.prompt: Si el bebé ___ la siesta, salimos a pasear después.
items.promptEnglish: If the baby naps, we go for a walk afterwards.
items.explanation: A routine, perfectly possible condition: si + presente. The subjunctive would make it sound unlikely.

items.prompt: Si viviéramos más cerca de los abuelos, todo ___ más fácil. (ser, condicional)
items.promptEnglish: If we lived closer to the grandparents, everything would be easier.

items.explanation: After si: no future, no conditional. The real condition is si + presente.

items.prompt: ¿Qué harías si tu hijo no ___ dormir nunca? (querer, imperfecto de subjuntivo)
items.promptEnglish: What would you do if your son never wanted to sleep?
items.explanation: Hypothetical: si + quisiera, matching the conditional harías.

items.prompt: Si le ___ música, se calma enseguida.
items.promptEnglish: If you put music on for him, he calms down right away.
items.explanation: A general truth about what always works: si + presente, presente.
